Vendor Mobile App

Complete guide to FindMyFlowers Business, the Android app for flower shop owners, florists and their staff: photograph and price bouquets at the vase, check smart vases, handle orders, keep track of stock and design bouquets with the AI assistant.

FindMyFlowers Business · Android

Getting Started

Welcome Screen

Install FindMyFlowers Business on your Android phone and open it. The welcome screen offers two choices: Sign In if you already have a vendor account, or Create a vendor account to register a new shop from the phone.

The app uses the same account as the Vendor Portal at vendors.findmyflowers.pl. Anything you change in one appears in the other.

Sign In

Enter your vendor username and password, then tap Sign In. You stay signed in until you log out or your session expires; when it expires the app returns you here with a Session expired message. If the server cannot be reached, the app says so instead of reporting a wrong password.

Forgot Password

Tap Forgot password? under the sign-in button, enter the email address on your vendor account and tap Send. A password-reset link is emailed to you.

Create a Vendor Account NEW

Step 1 — Your Business

From the welcome screen tap Create a vendor account. Choose Flower shop or Freelance florist, then enter your business name, an optional description, a contact email and an optional contact phone. Tap Next.

Step 2 — Shop Address

Customers find your bouquets on the map at this address, so it must be validated before you can continue. Either Type address (street, postal code, city, country) or switch to Point on map and tap your shop's location. The ◎ button uses your phone's current location.

Tap Validate address and pick the matching suggestion from the list. The pin moves to the confirmed spot.

Enter the address
Pick a validated match

Step 3 — Billing Address

Leave Same as shop address ticked, or untick it and enter a separate billing address for invoices. Your free trial starts as soon as the account is created. A payment card is not collected in the app; add one later from Billing in the Vendor Portal.

Step 4 — Your Login

Choose a username and a password (at least 8 characters with letters and numbers), confirm the password, accept the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy, and tap Create account. When the account is ready, restart the app and sign in with the new username. New accounts may stay pending approval until a platform administrator approves them.

Home

Home Dashboard

After signing in you land on Home, which shows your shop at a glance:

Online Vases: how many of your registered vases sent a heartbeat in the last five minutes (for example 1 of 2 registered). Bouquets · Available: bouquets customers can buy now. New Orders · Pending: orders waiting for you.

Quick Actions open the main tasks: Manage Vases & Upload Photos, View Bouquets, Bouquet Map, Stock and AI Florist. Recent Activity lists the latest bouquet and order events.

The + button at the top right adds a bouquet. The ☰ button opens the More menu. The bottom bar switches between Home · Bouquets · Orders · Alerts · More.

My Vases on Home

Scroll down Home to see each vase with an Online (green) or Offline (red) badge and when it was last seen. Use View Details or Upload Photo directly from here, or View All Vases for the full list. A vase is offline when it has not sent a heartbeat for more than five minutes. Check its power and Wi-Fi.

Smart Vases

My Vases

Opened from Manage Vases & Upload Photos, View All Vases or More → My Vases. Each card shows the vase serial number, its installation status and the latest temperature and humidity readings. Tap a card for details, or tap the camera button to photograph the bouquet in that vase.

Vase Details

Shows the device's Status (installation), Health, Last Heartbeat, live Sensor Data (temperature, humidity) and the Current State of its bouquet. Upload New Photo replaces the bouquet photo customers see. Scan QR in the top bar opens the QR scanner.

An offline vase shows Critical health, its last heartbeat time, and its last readings. Those readings may be stale (often 0.0), so check the device before acting on them.

Online vase
Offline vase

Scan a Vase QR Code

Tap Scan QR and point the camera at the QR code on the vase to jump to that vase. The first time, Android asks for camera permission. Choose While using the app. The torch button lights dark corners. If the code can't be read, type the serial number or vase ID under Or enter vase ID manually and tap Go.

Camera permission (first use)
QR scanner

Upload a Bouquet Photo

From a vase, tap Upload New Photo (or the camera button). The phone camera opens automatically. Frame the bouquet in the vase, or use Take Photo / Choose from Gallery. The photo is compressed and uploaded; it becomes the picture customers see on the map. Then set a price (see Bouquets) to put the bouquet on sale.

Bouquets

My Bouquets

The Bouquets tab lists every bouquet with its photo, status, price, freshness rating and date. Filter by All, Listed, Sold or PendingPrice (photographed but not yet priced). The camera icon on a card updates that bouquet's photo; tap the card to open it.

Bouquet Details

Shows the bouquet photo, name, status, price and creation date, the vase it is assigned to (tap to open the vase) and that vase's temperature and humidity. Actions: Change Price, View Vase, View on Map and Delete Bouquet (asks you to confirm and cannot be undone).

Bouquet details
Actions

Change Price & Freshness Rating

Tap Change Price, enter the new price in PLN and tap Save. A Freshness rating sheet follows: keep the current rating, choose 1–3 flowers (how many days the bouquet is guaranteed fresh), or No rating. Customers see the rating as flower pictograms; it drops by one flower each day and never changes the price.

Setting a price makes a PendingPrice bouquet available for customers to buy.

Bouquet Map

Opened from Home → Bouquet Map, More → Bouquet Map or View on Map. It shows your bouquets as photo markers with their prices, at your shop address, as customers see them. Green-ringed markers are available; grey ones are not yet on sale. The list below the map opens each bouquet. ◎ shows your own location.

Add a Bouquet

Tap + at the top of Home or Bouquets. Select the vase, add a photo, enter a name, set the freshness rating with the slider and enter a price. Leave Make this bouquet available on to list it straight away, then tap Save Bouquet.

Orders

Orders

The Orders tab lists customer orders with order number, customer, item count, status, payment state, total and date. Use the filter chips (All, Paid, Preparing, ReadyForPickup, InDelivery …) to focus on one stage.

Order Details & Status Updates

Tap an order to see its status, payment, customer, fulfilment method (delivery or pickup), dates, delivery address, items with subtotal, delivery fee and total, and a Timeline of what happened. Cancelled orders show the cancellation reason.

Active orders show buttons for the next step: Accept & Prepare (paid order), then Ready for Pickup or Start Delivery, then Mark Delivered. Cancel Order asks for confirmation and cannot be undone.

Alerts

Alerts

The Alerts tab collects notifications for example when a vase goes offline, a bouquet is sold or a new vase is assigned to you. They are grouped into Today, Yesterday and Older. A badge on the tab shows unread alerts. Tap a vase alert to open that vase.

More Menu

More

The More tab (also the ☰ button) lists everything else: Bouquet Map, AI Florist, Stock, Profile Settings, My Vases, Order Smart Vases, Analytics, Payments, Billing & Subscription, Customer Feedback, Opening Hours, Contact Us and Log Out.

Top of the menu
Bottom of the menu

Stock NEW

Stock Overview

Open Home → Stock or More → Stock to see the flowers, greenery and materials you have on hand. The tiles count Items, Low stock and Out of stock; Stock value totals quantity × unit cost (items without a cost are not counted). Search by name, colour or supplier and filter by All / Low / Out / Archived and by kind. Tap Add stock item to add a new item.

Stock Item & Updates

Tap an item to see its quantity, status, unit cost, stock value, low-stock alert level, last delivery and notes. Edit changes its details.

Under Update stock choose what happened: Received (a delivery; a unit cost entered here becomes the item's current cost), Used, Wasted or Counted (a stock-take that sets the exact quantity). Enter the quantity and an optional note, then Save. The History below lists every change with the quantity after it. Archive item hides items you no longer stock.

Item and update form
History

Add a Stock Item

Choose the Kind (Flower, Greenery or Material), enter the name, an optional colour, the quantity on hand now (recorded as opening stock), an optional unit cost, a low-stock alert level, supplier and notes, then tap Add to stock. Flowers and greenery are counted in stems. The AI Florist uses these unit costs when it prices recipes.

AI Florist NEW

1 — Start With What You Have

The AI Florist suggests bouquets you can make from flowers you already have, with stem counts, assembly steps and costs. Open it from Home or More → AI Florist.

Take photo or Choose photos (up to 5, in good light with stems separated) and the assistant recognises your flowers. Or tap Enter stock manually. Your remaining monthly allowance (photo scans, designs, previews) is shown under the buttons. Saved recipes opens recipes you kept.

2 — Check Your Stock

Review the list of flowers the assistant will use. Use my shop stock fills it from your Stock list. Adjust quantities with − / +, enter or correct the unit price, remove items with ✕ or + Add an item. Tap Confirm stock.

3 — Choose Your Design

Choose the bouquet size and an optional style, and optionally set a cost ceiling in PLN. The panel shows how many recipes will be created and how many designs you have left this month. Tap Create 3 recipes. Cost settings opens your costing preferences.

Cost Settings

Set the labour minutes per bouquet, your hourly rate, an overhead percentage and whether prices are Gross (including VAT) or Net, then Save. Remembered prices lists the unit prices you entered in earlier stock reviews; they are reused next time. These settings are private to your shop.

4 — Ideas From Your Stock

The assistant returns three bouquet ideas, each with its stem mix and known cost (with a note if a price is missing). Tap View recipe for the full recipe, or Generate preview for a picture of how the bouquet could look (each preview uses one from your monthly allowance). Change settings goes back a step.

5 — Recipe

The recipe lists each flower and stem count and numbered assembly steps. The cost summary shows flowers, materials and the known cost. Enter a Selling price to see your Margin. Actual flowers and stem counts may differ from the suggestion.

Save recipe keeps it under Saved recipes, Share sends it to another app, and I made it — use stock deducts the stems from your shop stock.

Recipe and assembly steps
Cost, margin and actions

Saved Recipes

Recipes you saved from the assistant appear here so you can make them again.

Business Settings

Store Information

More → Profile Settings shows who is signed in and your business details. Tap Edit Profile to change the business name, description, contact email and contact phone, then tap Save Changes. The contact email is shown to customers and is separate from your sign-in email.

Further down: Opening Hours →, your vendor type and location with Change Address →, the app version and server connection status, and Log Out.

Business information
Vendor and app information

Opening Hours

Switch each day open or closed and pick the opening and closing times, then tap Save Schedule. Customers see these hours on your shop profile.

Change Shop Address

Shows your current address. Type a new address or place a pin on the map, tap Validate address, then Save Address. All your bouquets move to the new location on the customer map.

Order Smart Vases

Vase Orders

More → Order Smart Vases lists the vase hardware orders you have placed, filterable by Pending, Confirmed, Shipped, Delivered and Cancelled, with the courier tracking number once shipped. Tap Order Smart Vases to order more.

Place a Vase Order

Choose how many vases you need (1–10) with − / +, enter the shipping address and optional delivery notes, and tap Place Order. The platform team reviews the order and ships the vases. No payment is taken in the app.

Insights

Analytics

Revenue, average order value, total orders, active vases, bouquets sold and available bouquets. Switch the period between Today, 7 days, 30 days and All.

Payments

Payment activity over the last 30 days: paid orders, failed payments, refunds, disputes, refund rate and the most used payment method. Needs Attention lists payments to follow up, filtered by Retry Refund, Disputed and Refund Failed.

Customer Feedback

Ratings and reviews customers left on their orders. Set a minimum rating with − / + and tap Filter.

Billing & Support

Billing & Subscription

Shows your FindMyFlowers platform plan, its status and trial or renewal dates, and lets you cancel the subscription. If no plan is found you'll see a notice like the one here. To add or replace a payment card, the app opens the Vendor Portal's secure card page in your browser.

Contact Us & Log Out

More → Contact Us opens your phone's email app with a message to the FindMyFlowers team. Log Out (at the bottom of More, or on Profile Settings) signs you out immediately and returns to the welcome screen.
